h1: OK Hola — From your voice to a video
tagline: Describe your video by speaking or typing. The app builds the prompt for you.
login_desc: We email you a magic link. No passwords.
check_email: We emailed you a link. Open it to sign in.
describe_placeholder: e.g. A 30-second 3D animated video for TikTok where a friendly robot introduces a coffee shop. Upbeat tone, warm colors...
mic_unsupported: Voice dictation is not available in this browser. Please type your description.
library_empty: You have no saved prompts yet.
error_empty: Type or dictate a description first.
lp_hero_title: Describe your video by speaking. We build the prompt.
lp_hero_sub: Tell OK Hola what video you want —3D animated, cartoon, miniseries, professional— in your own words. We turn your voice into a structured prompt, ready to edit and save. No line limits, no rigid templates.
lp_what_body: An app where you speak or type your video idea and get a clean, structured generation prompt: scenes, style, duration, format and platform. The prompt that used to take hours, in seconds.
lp_why_body: AI video tools all fail the same way: they force you to write the perfect prompt, with character limits and formats you don't understand. OK Hola flips it: you describe, the AI builds the prompt.
lp_how_1_b: Dictate with your voice or write freely. No 60-line limit.
lp_how_2_b: We turn your description into scenes, style, duration, format and platform.
lp_how_3_b: Review, tweak and save it to your library. Render and publish (coming soon).
lp_final_title: Your next video idea starts with your voice
lp_footer_note: Video rendering and social publishing: on the way.
